SOCIAL STUDIES — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #10
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: SOCIAL STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which statement about Enterprise Project at School is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Enterprise Project at School.
   B. Treat Enterprise Project at School as rumours only.
   C. Say Enterprise Project at School never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain Enterprise Project at School with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

2. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Hide all money underground
   B. Ignore prices in shops
   C. Avoid saving forever
   D. Plan income and spending wisely

3. Which statement about Interdependence of people is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Interdependence of people as rumours only.
   B. Say Interdependence of people never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Interdependence of people.
   D. Explain Interdependence of people with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

4. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Obeying laws and caring for public property
   B. Destroying road signs
   C. Avoiding all community work
   D. Littering in markets

5. Which statement about Location and size of the County is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Location and size of the County.
   B. Explain Location and size of the County with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

   D. Say Location and size of the County never happens in Kenya.

6. Which statement about Physical features in the County is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)

   C. Treat Physical features in the County as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Physical features in the County.

7. Which statement about Aspects of Traditional Culture in the County. is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)

   B. Skip evidence when discussing Aspects of Traditional Culture in the County..
   C. Explain Aspects of Traditional Culture in the County. with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat Aspects of Traditional Culture in the County. as rumours only.

8. Which statement about Industries in the County is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Industries in the County with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Industries in the County never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Industries in the County as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Industries in the County.

9. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Measure rainfall only
   B. Name the president
   C. Explain symbols used on a map
   D. Replace the compass rose

10. Which statement about Economic activities in the County is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Economic activities in the County as rumours only.
   B. Explain Economic activities in the County with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Economic activities in the County.
   D. Say Economic activities in the County never happens in Kenya.

11. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Nairobi
   B. Mombasa
   C. Nakuru
   D. Kisumu

12. Which statement about Historic Built Environments in the County is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Historic Built Environments in the County as rumours only.
   B. Say Historic Built Environments in the County never happens in Kenya.
   C. Explain Historic Built Environments in the County with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Historic Built Environments in the County.

13. Which statement about The School is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing The School.
   B. Say The School never happens in Kenya.
   C. Explain The School with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat The School as rumours only.

14. Which statement about Seasons in the County is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Seasons in the County as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Seasons in the County.
   C. Say Seasons in the County never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain Seasons in the County with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

15. Which statement about Population Distribution is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Population Distribution.
   B. Explain Population Distribution with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Population Distribution as rumours only.
   D. Say Population Distribution never happens in Kenya.

16. Which statement about Compass Direction is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Compass Direction.
   B. Treat Compass Direction as rumours only.
   C. Say Compass Direction never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain Compass Direction with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Seasons in the County and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
